thought.text: Let me check the rest of the plugin and whether `CI` is set in this container (it affects test timeouts — 15s local vs 60s CI).

reasoning_content:
Important detail: `testTimeout: process.env.CI ? 60_000 : 15_000`. In other words, the CI environment variable doubles the timeout to 60 seconds. The 60-second timeout for refactoring-properties indicates that CI=true was set during the install run. Interesting. In this container, CI may be set globally. Let me check env.

Let me also check the rest of the appWrapper plugin and take a look at the CI environment variable.

action.command: cd /workspace; sed -n 80,160p vite.config.ts; echo ---; env | grep -iE "^CI=|^MISE" ; echo "env-grep-done"; cat .gitlab-ci.yml | grep -iE "CI=|test-suite|staging" | head
